value.rationale: Natural exact isogeny-neighbor valency over every odd finite field for a canonical D4 pencil, with full coefficient-frequency classification. Equal rational J[2] orders can hide drastically different rational maximal isotropic subgroup counts, 3 versus 7; this matters for rational polarized (2,2)-isogeny correspondences even when the target is decomposable. Not a random parameter slice or textbook substitution. The deliberate restriction to kernels rather than codomains avoids unproved downstream claims.
